tools.name: vehicle_risk
tools.description: Returns recorded NHTSA complaint flags, distinct-record system and subsystem counts, recalls, investigations, manufacturer communications, source coverage, an optional verified sales-denominator rate, and separately labeled Jev model tags for one make, model and year. Jev tags exist for model years

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Returns compact recorded facts for two to five vehicles and factual orderings by complaints, recalls and available verified complaints-per-100k-sold rates. Unknown vehicles include database suggestions; unrated vehicles remain explicitly unrated. Counts reflect source coverage and a sales proxy wher

tools.name: listing_changes
tools.description: Returns paginated observations of listing changes with VIN, price, mileage, dates, source and link, filtered by vehicle, event type or date.
